headline: TJX Tops Third-Quarter Revenue Forecasts as Shares Rise
summary: Off-price retailer TJX reported third-quarter revenue that exceeded market expectations, prompting a gain in its stock price.
why: TJX Companies is the leading off-price apparel and home fashions retailer in the United States.

impacts.name: TJX Companies
impacts.why: Beating consensus sales estimates supported equity upside in morning trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Quarterly sales results topping market forecasts boosted investor demand for the off-price retail stock.
